block: held-out root 36,000,000, corrected controller, executed once

condition_2_adaptation.metric: replay-verified adequate viable-mode adaptation, REACTIVE, Part B

decision_rules.immutability: No controller, threshold, environment, comparator, metric, analysis rule, sample size or interpretation criterion may be changed after authorization. The block is executed exactly once. No V7, no correction cycle and no additional held-out evaluation follows, regardless of outcome.

part_a_scripted.rule: Part A is NOT required to show superiority over deployment-informed FIXED. It is reported separately and never pooled with Part B.

decision_rules.pooling: PROHIBITED. Parts A and B are never pooled to determine success.

predictive.rule: No required success threshold. The PREDICTIVE-minus-REACTIVE comparison is reported regardless of direction.

conditions_all_required: corrected REACTIVE has lower overall_rmse_m than deployment-informed FIXED, with the paired 95% CI excluding zero in REACTIVE's favour
adequate viable-mode adaptation exceeds 50%, using the already-defined replay-verified metric (corrected pilot definition, adequate_rate)
primary_claim.scope: Part B generated changing environments ONLY
primary_claim.supported_if: both conditions hold; otherwise not supported

decision_rules.status: FROZEN BY THE RESEARCHER BEFORE AUTHORIZATION. Immutable.

supporting_outcomes.rule: Reported as supporting outcomes only. NO composite pass criterion is constructed from them and none of them can overturn or establish the primary claim.
